name: PRE-084
summary: A sigma-1 receptor agonist derived structurally from PCP. It is reported to have cognitive enhancing effects as well as antidepressant effects. Studies are being conduced on its potential use in treating many nervous system diseases such as ALS and parkinsons.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: PRE-084 is a sigma receptor agonist, selective for the σ1 subtype.

summaryZh: PRE-084是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C19H27NO3，能作為σ受體特別是σ1的選擇性激動劑，在動物實驗中有益智藥、抗抑鬱藥和止咳藥作用。
summaryZhHans: PRE-084是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C19H27NO3，能作为σ受体特别是σ1的选择性激动剂，在动物实验中有益智药、抗抑郁药和止咳药作用。
